name: Stormblade (Major Artifact)
body:
Aura strong evocation (evil) CL 20th; Slot weapon; Price —; Weight 10 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

Stormblade is a Large +6 unholy longsword—as with all slashing weapons, Stormblade becomes a vorpal weapon in the hands of a balor. The body of a creature decapitated by Stormblade is disintegrated if the decapitation results in death, and heals the wielder of 100 points of damage.

DESTRUCTION

Stormblade melts into blood and mist if its long-dead nascent demon lord owner is restored to life.
